title: Guardian may skip feasibility on $660M Nevada tungsten mine

facts.claim: Guardian Metal Resources said it could begin preparing to build the Pilot Mountain tungsten project by August next year based on its prefeasibility study.
facts.subject: Guardian Metal Resources
facts.cause: market conditions and US supply pressures may allow the project to proceed without a full feasibility study

facts.claim: The Pilot Mountain prefeasibility study estimated a post-tax net present value of $660.3 million at an 8% discount rate.
facts.subject: Pilot Mountain tungsten project

facts.claim: The Pilot Mountain prefeasibility study estimated an internal rate of return of 59.6%.
facts.subject: Pilot Mountain tungsten project

facts.claim: The Pilot Mountain prefeasibility study outlined a one-year payback on $288.7 million in initial capital costs.
facts.subject: Pilot Mountain tungsten project

facts.claim: China produces about four-fifths of the world's mined tungsten supply.
facts.subject: China

facts.claim: China tightened tungsten export controls in February last year.
facts.subject: China

facts.claim: Guardian received a $6.2 million Defense Production Act award to help fund the Pilot Mountain prefeasibility study.
facts.subject: Guardian Metal Resources
facts.cause: Washington is pushing to rebuild metals supply for defence, aerospace and technology

facts.claim: Guardian shares last traded at $14.21 on Tuesday afternoon, giving the company a market capitalization of $553.5 million.
facts.subject: Guardian Metal Resources

facts.claim: Guardian plans to file its mine plan with the Bureau of Land Management next month.
facts.subject: Guardian Metal Resources

facts.claim: The Pilot Mountain base case used a tungsten trioxide price of $197,300 per tonne, which was a 35% discount to the June 12 ammonium paratungstate spot price.
facts.subject: Pilot Mountain tungsten project

facts.claim: At the June 12 ammonium paratungstate spot price, Pilot Mountain's after-tax value rises to $1.4 billion, its return rises to 102% and its payback falls to six months.
facts.subject: Pilot Mountain tungsten project
facts.cause: using the June 12 ammonium paratungstate spot price instead of the base-case price assumption
